assistant_outcomes.text: Pulling the repo page and a quick look at how it sits next to your Mag/DeepSeek setup.

**[Vizards/deepseek-v4-for-copilot](https://github.com/Vizards/deepseek-v4-for-copilot)** — VS Code extension that puts **DeepSeek V4 Pro & Flash** into **GitHub Copilot Chat’s model picker**. You keep Copilot’s UI, agent mode, tools, MCP, skills, and instructions; only the model backend is yours (BYOK). ### What it does | Piece | Detail | |--------|--------| | **Models** | V4 Flash (`none`/`low`/`high`/`max` thinking) · V4 Pro (`none`/`high`/`max`) · ~1M context | | **Stack** | Native Copilot provider API — agent, tool calling, `.instructions.md` / `AGENTS.md` | | **Vision** | V4 is text-only
Integrating DeepSeek V4 into your stack: checking Mag/DeepSeek config and your editor setup so we wire it cleanly.
Mag already uses V4 Flash/Pro. Wiring the Copilot extension as an IDE seat: install, align settings with Mag model IDs, document the seat.
DeepSeek V4 extension is in. Copilot Chat is already built-in (marketplace install conflicts). Wiring Mag seat + settings now.

**Integrated.** DeepSeek V4 sits in VS Code Copilot as a Mag IDE seat, same models as Mag headless. ### Done | Layer | Change | |--------|--------| | **Extension** | `Vizards.deepseek-v4-for-copilot` v0.7.0 installed | | **Settings** | User + Mag workspace: `baseUrl`, Flash/Pro ids match `providers.yaml` | | **Seat** | `vscode_copilot_deepseek` in `configs/seat_playbook.yaml` | | **Law** | `docs/ref/VSCODE_COPILOT_DEEPSEEK.md` + note in `MAG_SEAT_INTELLIGENCE.md` | | **Workspace** | `.vscode/extensions.json` recommends the extension | ### Route (unchanged law) - **Headless / queue / improve**
